content: Table TABREF1 compares the predictions of original LAMA and negated LAMA. As true answers of the negated statements are highly ambiguous, our measures are spearman rank correlation and overlap in rank 1 predictions between the original and negated dataset. Table TABREF4 gives examples of BERT-large predictions.
